_comment: The feed's OTHER row shape: a date that has already passed. Note what changes against
nasdaq-earnings-sample.json (the same feed for a date still ahead) — 'eps' and 'surprise'
appear, 'time' degrades to time-not-supplied for every row, and lastYearRptDt/lastYearEPS
are gone entirely. That is why a settled re-fetch has to be merged over the scheduled
roster rather than replacing it, or the BMO/AMC marker is lost.
These are real rows from real reporting dates, kept verbatim because each one is the
evidence for a rule: MSFT a clean beat, GOOG a clean miss, BA/CZR a loss-maker that lost
MORE than expected (a miss only if the surprise divides by the magnitude of the forecast),
ECL a company that met consensus to the cent and had its true zero published as N/A, MAA
the feed contradicting its own two columns, and WSO.B a reported figure no analyst covered.
Public market facts about public companies — no account data, as src/test/resources requires.
